searchQueries.title: Search queries (GitHub search syntax)
searchQueries.description: Free text queries passed to GitHub's /search/issues endpoint. Supports GitHub search syntax like 'langchain in:title,body', 'stars:>100 language:python label:bug', 'org:openai type:issue'. Leave empty if only watching specific repos below.

repos.title: Repos to watch (owner/name)
repos.description: Specific GitHub repos to pull issues from, in the format owner/name. Example: pinecone-io/pinecone-python-client, weaviate/weaviate. Leave empty if only using search queries above.

keywords.title: Keywords (client side filter)
keywords.description: Only items whose title or body contains any of these keywords are kept. Case insensitive. Leave empty to keep everything the search or repo poll returned.

itemType.title: Item type
itemType.description: Filter by item kind. Issues only excludes pull requests. PRs only returns pull requests. All returns both.

state.title: State
state.description: Filter by state. Open is the default. Closed returns closed items. All returns both.

labels.title: Labels filter
labels.description: Only keep items tagged with these labels. Example: bug, help wanted, good first issue. Multiple labels are ANDed together.

minRepoStars.title: Minimum repo stars
minRepoStars.description: Drop issues from repos with fewer than this many stars. Useful when you only want signal from production grade users. Set to 0 to keep everything.

maxAgeHours.title: Max age in hours
maxAgeHours.description: Skip items created more than this many hours ago. 0 keeps everything regardless of age.

sortBy.title: Sort
sortBy.description: Created returns newest first by creation date. Updated returns items most recently updated first.

maxItemsPerSource.title: Max items per query or repo
maxItemsPerSource.description: Per source cap. GitHub pages contain up to 100 items per page and the search endpoint caps at 1000 total results.

maxItemsTotal.title: Maximum items per run
maxItemsTotal.description: Hard cap on items pushed to the dataset per run. Controls cost.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip issue IDs pushed on previous runs. Stored in the key value store under SEEN_IDS. Turn off to return every match on every run.

githubToken.title: GitHub personal access token (optional)
githubToken.description: Raises the GitHub API rate limit from 60 core / 10 search per minute (anonymous) to 5000 core / 30 search per minute (authenticated). Generate a free token at github.com/settings/tokens. No scopes required for public data. For private repos, the token needs the repo scope.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings. The GitHub REST API is public and rate limited, not IP limited, so a proxy is rarely needed. Add one if your schedule triggers secondary rate limits.
